title: Getting Started: Your First Five Moves in Moving Checklist
summary: Start moving checklist this week with five concrete moves.
body:
Don't try to do everything. Do these five, in order:

1. 8 weeks: book movers, start decluttering
2. 6 weeks: gather supplies, pack non-essentials
3. 4 weeks: change address, transfer utilities
4. 2 weeks: pack most rooms; confirm movers
5. 1 week: first-night box, clean as you go

Five moves, one week. Momentum beats perfection — the rest of this guide builds on exactly this start.
facts: 2 weeks: pack most rooms; confirm movers
1 week: first-night box, clean as you go

A: 2 weeks before, minimum.
